contractPrinciples: Prefer cypher-llm-ir/v1 for new generation; use raw Cypher only for migration or source inspection.
Treat compiler diagnostics as model feedback, not user-facing blame.
Apply deterministic repairs before asking the model to regenerate.
Run proof or agent-feedback before execution, and require explicit approval for writes.
Use policy profiles and policy evidence for autonomous agents instead of hidden prompt-only rules.
Keep contract, schema, and example versions pinned when integrating external agent runtimes.

authoringRules.rawCypherUse: Use raw Cypher paths for legacy text2cypher outputs, round-trip inspection, or migration inventories.
neverExecuteWhen: requiresApproval is true and no external approval was supplied

workflows.title: Author a new read query
workflows.goal: Turn a user request and schema contract into executable, bounded Cypher.

steps.title: Emit structured IR
steps.successSignal: The query uses explicit variables, declared labels/relationships, and bounded return intent.
steps.failureHandling: Ask for missing schema context instead of inventing labels, relationship types, or properties.

steps.title: Get one-shot compiler feedback
steps.failureHandling: Follow nextAction.kind and diagnostic playbooks before producing a final query.

steps.title: Execute only after proof
steps.successSignal: canExecute is true and requiresApproval is false.
steps.failureHandling: Return the repair plan or approval request rather than executing unsafe Cypher.

workflows.title: Repair compiler feedback
workflows.goal: Convert diagnostics into deterministic edits or a targeted model regeneration.

steps.title: Request ranked repair steps
steps.successSignal: deterministic repairs cover all blocking diagnostics.
steps.failureHandling: Use modelRequired diagnostics as a compact regeneration target.

steps.title: Re-run proof after edits
steps.successSignal: status is accepted, accepted-with-warnings, or repaired.
steps.failureHandling: Do not execute until the proof status is not blocked.

workflows.title: Run policy-safe autonomous checks
workflows.goal: Make cost, tenant, sensitive-data, and write-risk decisions explicit.

steps.title: Select a named policy profile
steps.successSignal: The selected profile id is recorded in the policy report.
steps.failureHandling: Default to llm-readonly-strict for autonomous read agents.

steps.title: Run policy check with evidence
steps.successSignal: ok is true or only warning findings remain after explicit handling.
steps.failureHandling: Treat error findings as blockers unless a human approval path exists.

workflows.title: Migrate legacy raw Cypher
workflows.goal: Inspect and repair existing text2cypher outputs without losing source bytes.

steps.title: Preserve source spans
steps.failureHandling: Use source spans and diagnostics for targeted migration feedback.

steps.title: Lift supported reads into IR
steps.successSignal: The query can move to structured IR or has narrow raw repairs.
steps.failureHandling: Keep unsupported clauses explicit as raw-compatible escape hatches.

workflows.title: Check release compatibility
workflows.goal: Keep agent integrations stable across package releases.

steps.title: Fetch the compatibility catalog
steps.failureHandling: Block the release until duplicate or incomplete contract metadata is fixed.

steps.title: Compare baseline and candidate catalogs
steps.failureHandling: Review warning changes and block breaking changes unless a new contract version and migration plan exist.

diagnosticPlaybooks.instruction: Add or lower RETURN LIMIT before execution; prefer the configured defaultLimit unless the user asked for a smaller bound.
Use schema aliases when present; otherwise ask for schema context instead of inventing names.
Let deterministic repair flip direction only when schema endpoints make the change unambiguous.
Regenerate WITH, RETURN, or CALL subquery scopes so every referenced variable is introduced and exported deliberately.
Move aggregate predicates after WITH or RETURN, give aggregate outputs stable aliases, and avoid mixing scalar and aggregate projections ambiguously.
Bound relationship hops with defaultMaxHops and re-run policy checks before execution.
Do not execute writes until an external approval path sets allowWrites and approved.
Preserve source spans and migrate toward structured IR where supported; keep unsupported syntax explicit.
